name: Server Configuration
description: Server configuration file (e.g. TOML) covering server.properties-equivalent settings.

name: Handshake & Status
description: Handshake state and Server List Ping / Status protocol for pre-login server info.

name: Encryption
description: Login encryption using AES/CFB8 with RSA-1024 handshake, per Java Edition protocol.

name: Packet Compression
description: Zlib/Deflate packet compression negotiated after login.

name: Connection Timeout Handling
description: Timeouts to prevent clients from stalling indefinitely in login or other sequences.

name: Remote Administration
description: Query and RCON protocols for out-of-band server administration.

name: World Persistence
description: World loading and saving for the Overworld, Nether (DIM-1), and End (DIM1), including level.dat.

name: Chunk Loading & Saving
description: Chunk read/write support using the vanilla Anvil region storage format.

name: World Generation
description: Full chunk generation pipeline: RNG (Xoroshiro128 and legacy), biome maps (Overworld/Nether/End), noise-based terrain shaping, surface rules, bedrock layer, superflat generation, carvers (caves/ravines), decorative features, ore veins, and structures (villages, strongholds, monuments, fortresses, End cities, etc.) and structure-like features (dungeons, geodes, ice spikes, etc.).

name: World Physics
description: Liquid physics (water/lava flow) and the lighting engine.

name: Redstone
description: Full redstone system: signal propagation and update order, hard/soft power logic, redstone tick system, sensors (pressure plates, tripwire, sculk, daylight detector), timing components (repeater, comparator, observer), mechanisms (piston, dropper, dispenser, hopper, crafter, TNT, minecarts), and utility blocks (bell, lamp, doors, lectern, composter, note block).

name: World State
description: World time, world border, and world join/leave lifecycle handling.

name: World HUD Elements
description: Player tab-list, scoreboard, and bossbar synchronization.

name: Entity Spawning
description: Natural and rule-based entity spawning within the world.

name: Player Movement
description: Walking, sprinting, crouching, teleportation, animations, elytra flight, swimming/crawling states, and fall damage calculation.

name: Player State
description: Experience/leveling, hunger and saturation, eating/drinking, health regeneration, drowning, player attributes, and game mode switching.

name: Player Inventory & Appearance
description: Main inventory management, off-hand support, skins/property handling, armor and equipment visibility, and item cooldowns.

name: Player Progression
description: Advancements, statistics, recipe/recipe book unlocking, and player capabilities (creative flight, invulnerability).

name: Chat & Session Presentation
description: Chat signing/secure chat, tab-list formatting/headers, and command permission levels/nodes.

name: Core Combat
description: Melee attack logic, tool-based damage scaling, vanilla knockback, and attack speed/cooldown timing.

name: Combat Equipment
description: Bows, crossbows, shields, and tridents, including charging, loading, blocking, and thrown/melee states.

name: Combat Mechanics
description: Critical hits, invulnerability frames, sweep attacks, and enchantment/status effect integration in damage calculation.

name: Entity Types
description: Non-living entities (minecarts, thrown items), players, mobs, animals, villagers, and boss entities, including entity effects and saving.

name: Look Control
description: Head movement and look-at-target control for entities.

name: Navigation / Pathfinding
description: A*-based pathfinding navigation used to route entity movement through the world.

name: Jump Control
description: Controls entity jumping behavior, including jumping over obstacles along a path.

name: Move Control
description: Applies velocity toward the current pathfinding target.

name: MoveToBlockGoal
description: Moves an entity toward a specific target block.

name: RandomStrollGoal
description: Makes an entity wander to random nearby positions.

name: FollowParentGoal
description: Makes a baby animal follow its parent entity.

name: MeleeAttackGoal
description: Drives an entity to approach and melee attack its current target.

name: PanicGoal
description: Makes an entity flee erratically after taking damage or when threatened.

name: AvoidEntityGoal
description: Makes an entity actively avoid a specified type of entity.

name: FollowOwnerGoal
description: Makes a tamed entity follow its owner.

name: LookAtEntityGoal
description: Makes an entity turn its head to look at a nearby entity; implemented via the Look Control system.

name: RandomLookAroundGoal
description: Makes an entity periodically look in a random direction; implemented via the Look Control system.

name: EatBlockGoal
description: Makes an entity eat a block (e.g. grass) from the world.

name: TemptGoal
description: Makes an entity move toward a player holding a tempting item.

name: BreedGoal
description: Drives breeding behavior between two nearby entities in love mode.

name: BegGoal
description: Makes an entity (e.g. tamed wolf) beg when a player holds food nearby.

name: NearestAttackableTargetGoal
description: Selects the nearest valid attackable entity as a target.

name: HurtByTargetGoal
description: Sets the entity that damaged this mob as its target.

name: OwnerHurtTargetGoal
description: Sets a tamed entity's target to whatever damaged its owner.

name: Inventories & Particles
description: Server-side inventory systems (chests, furnaces, etc.) and particle effect handling.

name: Chat System
description: Server-side chat message handling and broadcast.

name: Command Senders
description: Support for Players, Console, and RCON as valid command senders, plus the Serverbound Chat Command packet.

name: /advancement
description: Grants, revokes, or queries player advancements.

name: /attribute
description: Queries or modifies entity attributes and their modifiers.

name: /ban
description: Bans a player from the server.

name: /ban-ip
description: Bans an IP address from the server.

name: /banlist
description: Lists banned players or IP addresses.

name: /bossbar
description: Creates and modifies boss bars.

name: /clear
description: Clears items from player inventories.

name: /clone
description: Copies blocks from one region to another.

name: /damage
description: Deals damage to entities.

name: /data
description: Gets, merges, modifies, and removes block entity, entity, and command storage NBT data.

name: /datapack
description: Controls loaded data packs.

name: /debug
description: Starts or stops a debugging session that outputs profiling information.

name: /defaultgamemode
description: Sets the default game mode for new players.

name: /deop
description: Revokes operator status from a player.

name: /dialog
description: Shows a dialog to players.

name: /difficulty
description: Sets the world difficulty.

name: /effect
description: Adds or removes status effects on entities.

name: /enchant
description: Enchants a player's held item.

name: /execute
description: Executes another command with modified execution context, conditions, and redirection.

name: /experience
description: Adds, sets, or queries player experience/levels.

name: /fetchprofile
description: Downloads player profiles by name from external servers.

name: /fill
description: Fills a region with a specific block.

name: /fillbiome
description: Fills a region with a specific biome.

name: /forceload
description: Forces chunks to constantly be loaded or not.

name: /function
description: Runs a function or function tag.

name: /gamemode
description: Sets a player's game mode.

name: /gamerule
description: Sets or queries a game rule value.

name: /give
description: Gives items to a player.

name: /help
description: Lists available commands or shows usage for a specific command.

name: /item
description: Manipulates items in block or entity inventories.

name: /jfr
description: Starts or stops a Java Flight Recorder profiling session.

name: /kick
description: Kicks a player from the server.

name: /kill
description: Kills entities (players, mobs, items, etc.).

name: /list
description: Lists players currently on the server.

name: /locate
description: Locates the nearest structure, biome, or point of interest.

name: /loot
description: Generates loot from loot tables and places it in the world or inventories.

name: /me
description: Displays a message emoting the sender's action.

name: /msg
description: Sends a private message to another player.

name: /op
description: Grants operator status to a player.

name: /pardon
description: Unbans a player.

name: /pardon-ip
description: Unbans an IP address.

name: /particle
description: Spawns particle effects in the world.

name: /perf
description: Captures a short performance profiling snapshot.

name: /place
description: Places a structure, jigsaw, template, or feature at a location.

name: /playsound
description: Plays a sound effect to players.

name: /publish
description: Opens the world to LAN.

name: /random
description: Generates random numbers or sequences.

name: /recipe
description: Gives or takes away recipes known by a player.

name: /reload
description: Reloads datapacks.

name: /return
description: Sets the return value/result for a function.

name: /ride
description: Mounts, dismounts, or evicts entities from vehicles.

name: /rotate
description: Rotates entities to face a direction or location.

name: /save-all
description: Saves the world to disk.

name: /save-off
description: Disables automatic world saving.

name: /save-on
description: Re-enables automatic world saving.

name: /say
description: Broadcasts a message to all players.

name: /schedule
description: Delays the execution of a function.

name: /scoreboard
description: Manages scoreboard objectives, players, and teams display.

name: /seed
description: Displays the world seed.

name: /setblock
description: Sets a single block in the world.

name: /setidletimeout
description: Sets the automatic kick timeout for idle players.

name: /setworldspawn
description: Sets the world spawn point.

name: /spawnpoint
description: Sets a player's individual spawn point.

name: /spectate
description: Makes a spectator-mode player spectate an entity.

name: /spreadplayers
description: Teleports entities to random spread-out locations.

name: /stop
description: Stops the server gracefully.

name: /stopsound
description: Stops sounds currently playing for players.

name: /summon
description: Summons an entity.

name: /tag
description: Adds or removes scoreboard tags from entities.

name: /team
description: Manages scoreboard teams and their membership/options.

name: /teammsg
description: Sends a message to a player's own team.

name: /teleport (tp)
description: Teleports entities to a location, entity, or with rotation/facing options.

name: /tell
description: Alias of /msg; sends a private message to another player.

name: /tellraw
description: Sends a raw JSON text component message to players.

name: /test
description: Runs, creates, and manages gametest test instances.

name: /tick
description: Controls the server's tick rate, freezing, and stepping.

name: /time
description: Sets, adds to, or queries the world time.

name: /title
description: Manages titles displayed to players.

name: /tm
description: Alias of /teammsg.

name: /transfer
description: Transfers players to another server.

name: /trigger
description: Sets a trigger-type scoreboard objective's value, usable by non-op players.

name: /unpublish
description: Closes the LAN world.

name: /version
description: Displays the server/game version.

name: /w
description: Alias of /msg.

name: /waypoint
description: Manages waypoints shown on the locator bar/map.

name: /weather
description: Sets the weather.

name: /whitelist
description: Manages the server whitelist.

name: /worldborder
description: Manages the world border size, center, and warning settings.

name: /xp
description: Alias of /experience.

name: Permissions
description: Operator levels for command access control.

name: Translations
description: Localization/translation key support for client-displayed text.
